# HEIC converter browser assets

Vendored from `@keeratita/heic-converter` version `0.3.0`.

- Source: https://github.com/keeratita/heic-converter
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.
- Included runtime files: `index.mjs` and `heic-decoder.wasm`.

The management application imports these files only when the browser cannot
decode a selected HEIC or HEIF photograph natively.
